sources.use_review_basis: Birreria Terzo Tempo links this current owner-branded digital menu from its own menu page. The existing Torino OSM static venue has the same name and Via Balme location and no v2 offers. Only explicit drink-item EUR prices and serving text are transcribed; food and the promotional Guinness row are excluded. No fee-free claim or freshness after the checked date is made. Independent PR review and protected dry-run are required before a public seed.
